question: Should `gog` permanently add the bounded `drive sync push` command proposed by this PR?
rationale: The implementation adds a new mutating command surface; VISION.md allows small Drive primitives but requires discussion for new API surfaces, and the canonical issue is explicitly awaiting sponsorship.

options.title: Sponsor bounded push
options.body: Accept the push-only, non-deleting command direction once proof and ordinary review requirements are satisfied.

options.title: Keep design open
options.body: Leave the issue and draft PR open while maintainers refine naming, scope, or whether this belongs in core.

options.title: Decline core command
options.body: Keep directory reconciliation in external scripts or tools and close the core proposal without merging the command.

recommendation.title: Sponsor bounded push
recommendation.body: Accept the push-only, non-deleting command direction once proof and ordinary review requirements are satisfied.

likelyOwner.reason: The Drive command and release history make this the strongest available product-direction owner.
